_readme: Video tools template. Copy to video.json in this folder, fill in your paths, delete the '_example' line and run: python pipeline/step0_video_editing/main_slice_videos.py. Relative paths are resolved against the folder this file is in.

slice._readme: Settings for main_slice_videos.py, which cuts the same time window out of every video in videos_dir. pattern = which files in videos_dir are videos (not searched recursively). start / end = the window, as HH:MM:SS (fractions allowed, e.g. 00:01:30.5) or seconds. output_dir = where the slices go, under the videos' own file names; null = <videos_dir>/sliced. overwrite = redo slices that already exist (false skips them). The cut is an ffmpeg stream copy (no re-encoding), which can only start on a keyframe, so a slice may begin slightly before start.
